prompt_instruction: Reject any use of superlatives or absolutes such as 'best', 'perfect', 'guaranteed', unless explicitly approved by US Legal.
All content must match official product specifications and documentation. Reject any information not supported by official sources.
Reject any performance claim that cannot be verified, such as 'lasts 20 years', 'saves 50% energy', or similar statements.
Reject any direct or indirect comparison to competitors, e.g., 'better than Sony', unless officially certified.
Reject any claim implying medical or health benefits, e.g., 'cures asthma', 'improves breathing', or similar.
Reject any environmental or sustainability claim, e.g., 'green', 'eco-friendly', unless explicitly approved by US Legal.
Reject any pricing-related claim that implies superiority or guarantee, e.g., 'lowest price', 'best deal', 'cheapest option', or 'price match guaranteed'.
Reject any statement implying absolute safety, e.g., 'child-proof', '100% safe', unless explicitly documented by LG.
Reject any unauthorized or unverified reference to certifications or badges, e.g., 'Energy Star', unless specified in official documentation.
Reject any use of slang or informal language. Require professional, neutral tone.
Reject any subjective or opinion-based adjectives, e.g., 'mind-blowing', 'amazing', 'incredible', or similar.
Reject any use of exclamation marks or emojis. Maintain professionalism in all content.
Reject any use of third-party trademarks or intellectual property outside of LG trademarks. Respect all IP rights.
Reject any content containing personally identifiable information such as names, phone numbers, or similar data.
